description: Push the product's context (the HUSTLIN.md fields) to Hustlin: what it is, who buys it, pricing, voice and allowed claims, the Look (what it looks like, plus photo URLs), goals, where tracked links go, and the permission mode. Only the fields given are changed. Owner only. Field reference: https://hustlin.ai/mcp.

description.description: What it does and for whom.

funnelDestination.description: Where tracked links send people (signup page, store listing).

goals.description: Current growth goals, one sentence each.

look.description: What the product physically looks like, for every generated picture: packaging, size, color, texture of the product itself, how it is served or used, where it lives, the light. A few sentences.

lookAlways.description: Things every picture should include, comma separated.

lookNever.description: Things no picture may show (including the generic version of the category), comma separated.

lookPhotoUrls.description: Public https URLs of photos of the real product (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB each). Fetched once and kept as reference images; replaces the product's photos. Up to 5.

mode.description: Permission mode: observe, approve or auto.

productId.description: The product id (from products or create_product).

voice.description: How Hustlin should write for this product: tone, words to use and avoid, claims that are allowed and claims that are not.

name: sync_context
title: Sync product context
